cv.projects.title: PROJECT
cv.projects.baseStructure.title: Base Structure (Backend Template)
cv.projects.baseStructure.techStack.core: Core, Data: .NET 9, C# 13, ASP.NET Core, EF Core, PostgreSQL.
cv.projects.baseStructure.techStack.auth: Auth: JWT, Refresh Token, BCrypt, RBAC.
cv.projects.baseStructure.techStack.api: API: RESTful API, Swagger, Versioning, Rate Limiting.
cv.projects.baseStructure.description.co: This is a robust e-commerce platform built with .NET 9, utilizing ASP.NET Core, Entity Framework Core, and MediatR. It follows Clean Architecture and CQRS design patterns for scalability and maintainability. Key features include secure user authentication with JWT, comprehensive product management, and robust validation with FluentValidation. The project use PostgreSQL for data storage, integrates extensive logging and error handling, and supports unit and integration testing for reliability. It is designed to handle high-traffic environments with a strong focus on security and performance optimization.
cv.projects.baseStructure.why.content: Created as a reusable backend template to accelerate development of new .NET projects with best practices already implemented, including authentication, authorization, logging, validation, and API documentation out of the box.
cv.projects.education.title: Education Management System
cv.projects.education.description.conten: This project is developed with a back-end using C# based on a 3-layer architecture. It integrates JWT Token for authentication, FluentValidation for input data validation, Entity Framework for data retrieval, AutoMapper for data standardization and mapping, and SQL Server as the database management system. On the front-end, the project utilizes React.js to fetch data from the API and provides an interactive, flexible user interface.
cv.projects.education.auth.content: Implemented secure JWT-based authentication with role-based access control for students, teachers, and administrators.
cv.projects.education.validation.content: Applied FluentValidation to validate all incoming requests, ensuring data integrity and preventing invalid data from entering the system.
cv.projects.education.mapping.content: Used AutoMapper to streamline mapping between domain entities, DTOs, and ViewModels, reducing boilerplate code and potential mapping errors.
cv.projects.education.student.content: Developed comprehensive student record management including enrollment, academic history, grades, and attendance tracking.
cv.projects.education.course.content: Built course management module for curriculum design, scheduling, and assignment of instructors to courses.
cv.projects.education.enrollment.content: Implemented enrollment workflow with prerequisites checking, capacity management, and automated confirmation notifications.
cv.projects.aiPlatform.title: AI Platform Development
cv.projects.aiPlatform.description.conte: Designed and developed an enterprise AI platform (AI Base Framework) to integrate AI capabilities into various business systems (ERP, DMS, CRM, HRM). Built modular monolith architecture with plugin-based extensibility and agent-based AI capabilities. Implemented RAG pipeline with PostgreSQL + pgvector, multi-provider AI gateway (Ollama, GPT, Claude, Gemini, DeepSeek), AI Agent runtime with tool calling, NL-to-SQL engine, and voice AI (Whisper STT, TTS). Containerized with Docker/Docker Compose, deployed with Nginx. Used Redis for caching and MinIO (S3-compatible) for document storage.
cv.projects.aiPlatform.overview.content: Designed and developed an enterprise AI platform (AI Base Framework) to integrate AI capabilities into various business systems (ERP, DMS, CRM, HRM).
cv.projects.aiPlatform.architecture.cont: Built modular monolith architecture with plugin-based extensibility and agent-based AI capabilities for seamless integration into existing enterprise systems.
cv.projects.aiPlatform.rag.content: Implemented RAG pipeline with semantic search using PostgreSQL + pgvector (HNSW index) for high-accuracy vector similarity search across enterprise documents.
cv.projects.aiPlatform.gateway.content: Integrated multi-provider AI gateway supporting Ollama (local offline), OpenAI GPT, Claude, Gemini, Azure OpenAI, and DeepSeek for flexible AI model deployment.
cv.projects.aiPlatform.agent.content: Built AI Agent runtime with tool calling, human-in-the-loop approval, and comprehensive audit logging for enterprise-grade compliance.
cv.projects.aiPlatform.nl2sql.content: Developed NL-to-SQL engine with SQL injection protection and RBAC-aware query generation, enabling natural language database queries with security.
cv.projects.aiPlatform.voice.content: Implemented Speech-to-Text (Whisper) and Text-to-Speech for voice AI interactions, enabling voice-enabled enterprise workflows.
cv.projects.aiPlatform.infra.content: Used Redis for distributed caching and session management, MinIO (S3-compatible) for document storage, and Docker/Docker Compose for containerized deployment.
cv.projects.aiPlatform.deploy.content: Containerized all services with Docker/Docker Compose, deployed with Nginx as reverse proxy, and configured health checks for production readiness.
